exposure: Amount of intravenous fluids administered intraoperatively
outcome: Extended postpartum hospital length of stay (>4 days)
cohort: 840 patients who underwent cesarean delivery during a 1-year period
finding: Type of anesthetic technique and amount of intraoperative fluids administered during cesarean delivery have important effects on the incidences of extended postpartum hospital length of stay and adverse events.
mod_finding: Parturients receiving general or epidural anesthesia had a 25.6% incidence of extended postpartum hospital stay, compared to a 9.6% incidence in those receiving spinal or combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
